newsitem.title: USA: ADT rejects Western Resources' bid.
newsitem.headline: ADT rejects Western Resources' bid.

text.p: ADT Ltd said Monday it will recommend that shareholders reject the hostile exchange offer of Western Resources Inc.

The ADT board of directors said Western's revised offer is inadequate and does not reflect the inherent value of ADT. The company added that the actual value of Western's offer could be "significantly" lower than the value stated by Western.
Earlier on Monday Western had raised the cash portion of its offer to $10 per share, from $7.50, while keeping the overall value of the bid at $22.50 per share.

ADT also said Western would not make a strong strategic partner and that a sale to Western would not offer any strategic opportunities for ADT or its shareholders. ADT added that it believed a combination of ADT and Western would produce unacceptable risks for all ADT stakeholders.

ADT said that a special general meeting has been called for July 8 to vote on Western's proposals to replace ADT directors with Western employees, and that it has filed a preliminary proxy statement opposing that proposal.
